Which wearable device, first sold in April 2015, quickly became the world's best-selling wearable?
questions.explanation: The Apple Watch debuted in April 2015 and rapidly dominated the wearable tech market, outselling competitors like Fitbit and Samsung. It remains the top-selling smartwatch globally, blending health tracking, notifications, and Apple ecosystem integration into one device.

questions.question: Which video game console has sold more units than any other in history?
questions.explanation: The PlayStation 2, released by Sony in 2000, has sold over 155 million units worldwide, making it the best-selling video game console of all time. It outlasted many of its successors on store shelves, remaining in production until 2013. Its massive library of over 4,000 games contributed greatly to its enduring popularity.

questions.question: Which limited-edition TI-84 Plus CE calculator came in a metallic gold finish paired with a black slide cover and black back?
questions.explanation: The "Golden Ratio" TI-84 Plus CE was a special edition graphing calculator released by Texas Instruments, featuring a striking metallic gold body contrasted with a black slide cover and black back. The name is a nod to the famous mathematical constant φ (approximately 1.618), which has long been associated with beauty and proportion — fitting for a visually distinctive device. It's a collector's favorite among math enthusiasts and calculator fans alike.

questions.question: Which Neuralink project received FDA breakthrough device designation in September 2024?
questions.explanation: Neuralink's Blindsight is a brain-computer interface implant designed to restore vision by bypassing damaged eyes and optic nerves entirely, stimulating the visual cortex directly. The FDA's breakthrough device designation, granted in September 2024, is intended to accelerate the development and review of devices that treat serious conditions. This designation signals significant regulatory momentum for Neuralink's vision-restoration ambitions.
